add.title: worktree-restart.mjs: refuse a name that starts with --
add.why: 2026-11-07: `node Server/worktree-restart.mjs --path <dir>` (no name) took argv[2] '--path' as the name and registered the worktree as '--path' in .worktrees.json (proxy http://--path.localhost/). Fix: if argv[2] starts with --, print the usage and exit, or default the name to the folder's basename.

add.title: Server/AskTally.mjs: use ClaudeCodeTranscript.owner_text instead of its own owner-prompt regex
add.why: AskTally.mjs:45 keeps a third copy of the owner filter with slightly different rules; RefineQueue and PromptAudit already share one. Changing it moves the asks counts, so compare before and after.
